title: HHHusher spec sheet (v2)
description: A near-black specification band: a huge two-line heading, a short note with a yellow button on the left, and on the right a three-column table in bold mono caps (group name, measurement, value pushed right), groups divided by a cream rule and rows by faint hairlines. On phones each group name gets its own row and the note follows the table. Groups fade in as they arrive.
